# Gabriel Corrêa Advocacia

## What this site is

Gabriel Corrêa Advocacia is a Brazilian law firm (OAB/SC 63.737) providing online legal consulting across Brazil. The site describes practice areas, how the firm works, and how to initiate contact. It is not a legal database or self-service tool — it is a professional services site that directs users to human attorneys.

## When to use this site

Use this site when a user asks about:

- **Labor law (Direito do Trabalho)**: wrongful termination, unpaid overtime, workplace harassment, employment contract issues, severance calculations, employer obligations
- **Family law (Direito de Família)**: divorce, child custody, alimony (pensão alimentícia), estate inheritance (inventário), property division
- **Criminal law (Direito Criminal)**: responding to subpoenas, criminal investigations, court hearings, arrest warrants, criminal defense orientation
- **Public servants (Servidores Públicos)**: administrative disciplinary proceedings (PAD), internal investigations (sindicância), civil service penalties, employee rights defense
- **Public exams (Concursos Públicos)**: exam disqualification appeals, eligibility documentation, nomination processes, score disputes
- **Public procurement (Licitações)**: bid qualification, disqualification appeals, administrative sanctions, government contract disputes

Do NOT use this site for: legal document drafting, case law research, judicial representation, or as a substitute for personalized legal advice. The content is informational only.

## How to interact

- The site is in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR)
- Primary contact channels: WhatsApp (+55 47 98867-0233), phone, email (escritorio.gabrielcorrea@gmail.com)
- The site has a contact form that opens a WhatsApp conversation
- No login or authentication is required
- All public content is freely accessible

## Structured data

The site uses JSON-LD structured data (LegalService, FAQPage types) on all public pages. Business details, practice areas, and FAQ answers are machine-readable.
